description: Preserved qualitative ecological requirements from the prior review. Numeric climate reference cards are in fichas-supervivencia.json. The prior biological source assessments have not been re-audited in this numeric-schema migration.
use_rule: Ecological evidence only. Prior review labels do not validate numerical survival limits. Do not compare these prose values or indirect proxies with NASA numbers or use them as hard survival rules.

requirements.requirement: Land that seawater does not reach
requirements.value: Vegetated ground above storm-surge level. Bramble Cay itself rose only about 3 m above high tide.
requirements.evidence: The species lived on a ~4 ha sand cay with a maximum elevation of about 3 m above high tide; repeated ocean inundation from storm surges destroyed its vegetation.

sources.title: Waller et al. 2017, Wildlife Research: The Bramble Cay melomys, a first mammalian extinction caused by human-induced climate change?

requirements.proxy_note: Sea level and storm surge are not in NASA POWER; the melomys package includes global sea-level data.

requirements.requirement: Herbaceous vegetation for food and shelter
requirements.value: Herb cover on the cay fell from 2.16 ha (2004) to 0.065 ha (March 2014).
requirements.evidence: Vegetation was its primary food; its collapse preceded the extinction.
